title: Fiddlehead Brewing Company

services.name: Tasting Room
services.desc: Our tasting room and original brewery, located at 6305 Shelburne Rd in Shelburne, VT, offers a selection of draft beers for growler fills and pints. We also have canned and bottled beers available for purchase. We carry a selection of Fiddlehead glassware, clothing, hats, and more for you or the beer lover in your life. Our tasting room is open for pints with indoor and outdoor seating available on a first come first serve basis. While we love dogs, we ask that you leave them at home. Retail merch can be ordered to ship or for store pickup by visiting this link. We do not have a kitchen to offer food, but you may bring in your own or order from our neighbors, Folino’s Pizza.
